Through Vitest 4, browser mode supports three providers: **Playwright** (`@vitest/browser-playwright`, recommended for CI and parallel runs), **WebdriverIO** (`@vitest/browser-webdriverio`), and **preview** (`@vitest/browser-preview`, which opens a real browser but can't simulate events programmatically, so it's meant for local development only).

According to the Vitest 5.0.0 release notes (https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/releases/tag/v5.0.0), **Vitest 5 removed the WebdriverIO provider package**. On Vitest ≥5, your choices are therefore Playwright and preview. If you're upgrading a project that uses WebdriverIO, plan to switch it to Playwright.
